_meta.note: Test fixture for npc-story-events NR1.3 (the real file is narrative-seed's character-vocab).

wanderer.description: A creature on the move with no fixed post.
wanderer.negative: Not a trader; it has nothing to sell.

trader.description: Exchanges goods; gives a market a face.
trader.negative: Not the market's rules — prices are the runtime's.

hermit.description: Keeps to one place and knows it well.

chronicler.description: Keeps and trades in history and rumor.
chronicler.negative: Not an oracle; it reports, it does not foretell.

clan-elder.negative: Not the clan's policy — the clan's needs are computed from world state.

warlord.description: Leads a hostile force on the world map.
warlord.negative: Not a rival that grows from meeting the player.

captive.description: Held against its will, found in a cage or a camp.

envoy.negative: Not a trader and not a clan elder.

companion.negative: Not a roster slot; joining is the runtime's ownership transfer.

none.description: The model cannot place this creature in any role.
none.negative: The seed is refused; a character must have a role.
